build_Prop_class: build a custom MOMA prop by subclassing Prop and implementing _build with an MJCF root element
set_pose_Prop: set the pose of a prop in the physics environment using position and quaternion arrays
render_rgb_Camera: render an RGB image from a Camera prop using the physics environment and specified dimensions
create_Block_prop: create a Block prop with configurable width, height, and depth dimensions for the simulation
disable_collisions_Prop: disable collision detection for all geoms in a prop by setting contype and conaffinity to zero
